items.title: China-Nexus Hackers Actively Exploiting React2Shell Vulnerability in The Wild
items.description: China-nexus threat groups are racing to weaponize the new React2Shell bug, tracked as CVE-2025-55182, only hours after its public disclosure. The flaw sits in React Server Components and lets an attacker run code on the server without logging in. items.title: PoC Exploit Released for Critical React, Next.js RCE Vulnerability (CVE-2025-55182)
items.description: A proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit for CVE-2025-55182, a maximum-severity remote code execution (RCE) flaw in React Server Components, surfaced publicly this week, heightening alarms for developers worldwide.
